title: O Worship The King
lyrics_original: On the wings of the storm.
In the dew and the rain.

bible_verses.english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker.
Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, saying, ‘Destroy!’

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, You are the Ancient of Days, robed in splendor and filled with unfailing grace. Thank You for being my strong Defender and my refuge in every season of life. Teach my heart to quiet itself before Your grandeur and to offer You praise with genuine joy. I place my trust once again in Your sovereign reign and loving care. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: O Worship The King invites us to lift our eyes above the noise of daily life and behold the majesty of our God. He is not a distant ruler, but our eternal Shield and Defender who wraps us in His grace and surrounds us with His love. As we sing of His power and splendor, our hearts are reminded that the One who commands the light is the very same Father who shelters us in His care. Today, let us freely offer Him our gratitude and rest securely in His unshakeable reign.
